6.1.1.v: In the room of the first portion, containing a single vowel, there are two.
6.1.1.e: In this अधिकार the doubling happens for the first एकाच् entity of the verb
6.1.1.sa: अधिकारोऽयम् । इतः परम् > [[6.1.12]] इति यावत्सु सूत्रेषु यत् द्वित्वं विधीयते, तत् द्वित्वं धातोः प्रथमस्य एकाच्-अवयवस्य भवति ।
6.1.1.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.2.v: Of that whose first syllable begins with a vowel, there are two in the room of the second portion containing a single vowel.
6.1.2.e: The द्वित्व mandated in the > [[6.1.1]] अधिकार happens for the second एकाच् component of an अनेकाच् अजादि word.
6.1.2.sa: > [[6.1.1]] अस्मिन् अधिकारे उक्तं द्वित्वमनेकाच्-अजादि-शब्दस्य द्वितीय-एकाच्-अवयवस्य भवति ।
6.1.2.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.3.v: The letters न् , द् , and र् being the first letter of a compound consonant and being part of the second syllable, are not reduplicated.
6.1.3.e: When doubling of an अनेकाच् अजादि  verb root is to be done, the नकार, दकार, and रेफ present at the beginning of a संयोग are not duplicated.
6.1.3.sa: अनेकाचः अजादेः धातोः द्वित्वे प्राप्ते ;  तस्मिन् धातौ  द्वितीय-एकाच्-समुदाये उपस्थितानाम्, संयोगस्य आदिभूतानाम् नकार-दकार-रेफाणाम्  द्वित्वं न भवति ।
6.1.3.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.4.v: The first of the two is called अभ्यास or Reduplicate.
6.1.4.e: When a repetition is done, the first entity out of the two is called अभ्यास.
6.1.4.sa: अस्मिन् द्वित्वप्रकरणे ये द्वे विहिते, द्वयोः यः 'पूर्वः' (प्रथमः), तस्य 'अभ्यास' इति नाम दीयते ।
6.1.4.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.5.v: The both are collectively called अभ्यस्त।
6.1.5.e: When the doubling happens in this अधिकार, the two copies are collectively referred as 'अभ्यस्त'.
6.1.5.sa: अस्मिन् द्वित्वप्रकरणे ये द्वे विहिते, तयोः  द्वयोः मिलित्वा  'अभ्यस्त' इति संज्ञा भवति ।
6.1.5.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.6.v: So also the six roots beginning with जक्षि are called अभ्यस्त।
6.1.6.e: The verb roots belonging to the जक्षित्यादिगण are called 'अभ्यस्त'.
6.1.6.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.7.v: In the room of a short vowel of the Reduplicate of the the roots तुज् etc., a long is substituted.

6.1.8.v: When the tense-affixes of the Perfect follow, there is reduplication of the root, which is not already reduplicated.
6.1.8.e: When followed by a प्रत्यय of लिट् लकार,  a verb root that have not yet undergone द्वित्वम् undergoes द्वित्वम्.
6.1.8.sa: लिट्-लकारे परे यस्य धातोः द्वित्वम् न कृतमस्ति तस्य द्वित्वं भवति ।
6.1.8.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.9.v: Of a non-reduplicate root ending in सन् (Desiderative) or यङ् (Intensive) affixes, there is reduplication.
6.1.9.e: When followed by the सन्-प्रत्यय or the  यङ्-प्रत्यय, a verb root that have not yet undergone द्वित्वम् undergoes द्वित्वम्.
6.1.9.sa: सन्-प्रत्यये परे यङ्-प्रत्यये वा परे यस्य धातोः द्वित्वम् न कृतमस्ति तस्य (यथानिर्दिष्टम्) द्वित्वं भवति ।

6.1.10.v: Of a non-reduplicate root there is reduplication when the विकरण श्लु follows.
6.1.10.e: When a प्रत्यय is removed using the word श्लु, अङ्ग which is not yet duplicated is duplicated.
6.1.10.sa: श्लौ परे यस्य धातोः द्वित्वम् न कृतमस्ति तस्य (यथानिर्दिष्टम्) द्वित्वं भवति ।
6.1.10.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.11.v: Of a non-reduplicate root there is reduplication when the affix चङ् of the Aorist follows.
6.1.11.e: When followed by the चङ्-प्रत्यय, a verb root that have not yet undergone द्वित्वम् undergoes द्वित्वम्.
6.1.11.sa: चङ्-प्रत्यये परे यस्य धातोः द्वित्वम् न कृतमस्ति तस्य द्वित्वं भवति ।
6.1.11.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.12.v: The participles दाश्वाम् , साह्वान् , and मीढ्वान् are irregularly formed without reduplication.

6.1.13.v: There is vocalisation of the semi-vowel य् of the affix ष्यङ् [[4.1.78]] when followed in a तत्-पुरुष compound, by the words पुत्र and पति।

6.1.14.v: There is vocalisation of the affix ष्यङ् [[4.1.78]] when the word बन्धु follows in a बहुव्रीही compound.

6.1.15.v: The semi-vowels of the roots वच् , स्वप् , and यजादि verbs are vocalised when followed by an affix having an indicatory क।

6.1.16.v: There is vocalisation of the semi-vowels of the following verbs, when an affix having an indicatory क् or ङ् follows - ग्रह 'to take', ज्या 'to become old', वेञ् 'to weave', व्यध 'to strike', वश 'to shine', व्यच 'to deceive', व्रश्च 'to cut', प्रच्छ 'to ask' and भ्रस्ज 'to cook, to fry'.

6.1.17.v: There takes place a vocalisation of the semi-vowels of the reduplicate (अभ्यास) of both वाच्यादि [[6.1.15]] and ग्रहादि [[6.1.16]] words, when affixes of लिट् follow.

6.1.18.v: Of the causative verb स्वपि 'to cause one to sleep', there is vocalisation of the semi-vowel, when the affix चङ् of the Reduplicated Aorist follows.

6.1.19.v: There is vocalisation of the semi-vowel, of the verbs स्वप् 'to sleep', स्यम् 'to shout' and व्ये 'to cover', when followed by the affix यङ् of the Intensive.

6.1.20.v: There is not vocalisation of the semi-vowel of वश्, when the affix यङ् follows.

6.1.21.v: The verb की is substituted for the verb चायृ 'to worship, to observe', when the Intensive affix यङ् follows.

6.1.22.v: The स्फी is the substitute of स्फाय 'to swell', the निष्ठा affixes follow.

6.1.23.v: The verb स्त्या (स्त्यै and ष्ठ्यै) when preceded by प्र changes its semi-vowel to a vowel, when a निष्ठ affix follows.

6.1.24.v: There is vocalisation of the semi-vowel of the root श्या (श्यै) 'to go' when the निष्ठा affix follows, when the sense is 'coagulation' or 'cold to touch'.

6.1.25.v: There is vocalisation of श्या preceded by the उपसर्ग प्रति , when the निष्ठा affixes follow.

6.1.26.v: There is optionally the vocalisation of the श्या followed by निष्ठा affixes, when the उपसर्गs अभि and अव precede it.

6.1.27.v: Optionally शृत is formed in the sense of 'cooked', by the vocalisation of the semi-vowel of आ before the निष्ठा affix क्त।

6.1.28.v: पी is optionally the substitute of the root प्याय् 'to increase' before the निष्ठा affixes.

6.1.29.v: There is substitution of पी for प्याय् when the affixes of the Perfect (लिट्) and the Intensive (यङ्) follow.

6.1.30.v: There is optionally the vocalisation of the semi-vowel श्वि before the affixes of the Perfect and the Intensive.

6.1.31.v: There is optionally the vocalisation of the semi-vowel, in the causative of श्वि , when followed by the Desiderative सन् and the Aorist चङ् affix.

6.1.32.v: There is the vocalisation of the semi-vowel of the causative of ह्वे before the Desiderative and the Reduplicated Aorist affixes.

6.1.33.v: There is vocalisation of the semi-vowel of ह्वा in the reduplicated form, in both the syllables.

6.1.34.v: In the छन्दस् , the semi-vowel of this root is diversely vocalised.

6.1.35.v: For चाय् is diversely substituted की in the छन्दस्।

6.1.36.v: In the छन्दस् the following irregular forms are met with - अस्पृधेथाम् , आनृचुः , आनृहुः , चिच्युषे , तित्याज , श्राताः , श्रितम् , आशीः , आशीर्त्तः।

6.1.37.v: When a semi-vowel base has been vocalised, there is no vocalisation of the other semi-vowel that may precede it in the same word.

6.1.38.v: In the substituted root वय [[2.4.41]], the य in the Perfect is not vocalised.

6.1.39.v: Before the tense-affixes of the Perfect that have an indicatory क [[1.2.5]], for the य् of वय् may optionally be substituted a व्।

6.1.40.v: The semi-vowel of वे 'to weave' is not vocalised in the Perfect.

6.1.41.v: The semi-vowel of वे 'to weave' is not vocalised in the Participial affix ल्यप् follows.

6.1.42.v: The semi-vowel of ज्या 'to grow old' is not vocalised when the affix ल्यप् follows.

6.1.43.v: The semi-vowel of व्या (व्ये) 'to cover' is not vocalised when the affix ल्यप् follows.

6.1.44.v: The vocalisation may optionally take place when व्ये preceded by परि takes the affix ल्यप्।

6.1.45.v: In a root, which in the system of grammatical instruction (i.e. the धातुपाठ), ends with a diphthong (ए , ऐ , ओ, औ), there is the substitution of आ for the diphthong, provided that no affix with an indicatory श् follows it.

6.1.46.v: There is not the substitution of आ for the diphthong of the root व्ये when the affixes of the Perfect follow.

6.1.47.v: In the roots स्फुर् and स्फुल् 'to move', there is the substitution of the आ for the diphthong when the affix घञ् follows.

6.1.48.v: The substitution of आ for the diphthong takes place in the causatives of the roots क्री 'to buy, to purchase', इ 'to study' and जि 'to conquer'.

6.1.49.v: The substitution of आ takes for the diphthong in the causative of सिध् , when it does not refer to the next life.

6.1.50.v: And there is substitution of आ for the finals of मी 'to hurt', मि 'to scatter' and दी 'to decay' when the affix ल्यप् follows, as well as before those affixes which demand this substitution for the diphthong.

6.1.51.v: There is optionally the substitution of आ for the final of ली 'to adhere', in the धातुपाठ , when the affix ल्यप् follows or such an affix as would demand this substitution of the diphthong.

6.1.52.v: There is optionally the substitution of आ in the room of the diphthong of the verb खिद् 'to suffer pain', in the छन्दस्।

6.1.53.v: There is optionally the substitution of आ in the room of the diphthong of the root गुर् 'to exert' when preceded by the preposition अप and taking the affix णमुल्।

6.1.54.v: There is optionally the substitution of आ in the room of the diphthong of the roots चि and स्फुर् when in the Causative.

6.1.55.v: There is optionally the substitution of आ in the room of the diphthong of the root वी in the causative, when meaning 'to conceive an embryo'.

6.1.56.v: There is optionally the substitution of आ in the room of the diphthong of the root भी 'to fear' in the causative, when the fear is produced directly through the agent of the causative.

6.1.57.v: There is invariably the substitution of आ for the diphthong of the root स्मि 'to smile' in the causative, when the astonishment is produced directly through the agent of the causative.

6.1.58.v: The augment अम् (अ) comes after the ऋ or सृज् 'to create' and दृश् 'to see', when an affix beginning with a झल् letter (the Mute and the Sibilant) follows: provided that it has no indicatory क।

6.1.59.v: The augment अम् (अ) augment comes optionally after the ऋ of those roots which are exhibited in the धातुपाठ as अनुदात्त , when such roots end in a consonant having a ऋ has penultimate and are followed by an affix beginning with a mute or sibilant and not having an indicatory क।

6.1.60.v: The word शीर्षन् 'head', is found in छन्दस्।

6.1.61.v: There is the substitution of this stem शीर्षन् for शिरस् when a तद्धित-affix beginning with य follows.

6.1.62.v: There is the substitution of शीर्ष for शीरस् when a तद्धित-affix beginning with a vowel follows.

6.1.63.v: In the weak cases (beginning with the accusative plural) the following stems are substituted: पद for पाद , दत् for दन्त , नस् for नासिका , मास् for मास , हृद् for हृदय , निश for निशा , असन् for असृज् , यूषन् for यूष , दोषन् for दास् , यकन् for यकृत् , शकन् for शकृत् , उदन् for उदक and आसन् for आस्य।
6.1.63.e: The आदेशाs पद्,दत्,नस्, मास्, हृत्, निश्, असन्, यूषन्, दोषन्, यकन्, शकन्, उदन्, आसन् are created (to the appropriate words) in presence शस् and other विभक्तिs from तृतीया onwards.
6.1.63.sa: शस्-प्रभृतिषु प्रत्ययेषु परेषु पद्-दत्-नस्-मास्-हृत्-निश्-असन्-यूषन्-दोषन्-यकन्-शकन्-उदन्-आसन् एते आदेशाः विकल्पेन  भवन्ति ।
6.1.63.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.64.v: There is the substitution of स in the room of the ष् being the initial of a verbal root as enunciated in the धातुपाठ।
6.1.64.e: A षकार present at the beginning of औपदेशिक  form of a धातु is converted to सकार.
6.1.64.sa: धातोः औपदेशिकस्वरूपे आदिस्थस्य षकारस्य सकारादेशः भवति ।
6.1.64.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.65.v: There is the substitution of न् for the initial ण् of the root in the धातुपाठ।
6.1.65.e: A णकार present at the beginning of औपदेशिक form of a धातु is converted to नकार.
6.1.65.sa: धातोः औपदेशिकस्वरूपे आदिस्थस्य णकारस्य नकारादेशः भवति ।
6.1.65.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.66.v: There is लोप-substitution (elision) of the व् and य् when followed by any consonant except य्।
6.1.66.e: A वकार and a यकार are deleted when followed by a letter of the वल् प्रत्याहार.
6.1.66.sa: वल्-प्रत्याहारस्य वर्णे परे वकार-यकारयोः लोपः भवति ।
6.1.66.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.67.v: There is the elision of the affix वि when reduced to the single letter व्।
6.1.67.e: The प्रत्यय 'वि' is removed when it appears अपृक्त.
6.1.67.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.68.v: After a consonant there is the elision of the nominative affix स् and the tense-affix ति and सि (when reduced to the form of त् and स् ) being consonants; and so also after the long vowels ई and आ of the feminine (affix ङी and आप् ), there is the elision of the nominative affix स्।
6.1.68.e: The सुँ, ति, or सि प्रत्यय, when present as a single letter, is removed when attached to - (1) a word ending in a  हल् letter,  or (2) A दीर्घ word ending in the  ङीप् / ङीष् / ङीन् / चाप् / टाप् / डाप् प्रत्यय.
6.1.68.sa: हलन्तात्, दीर्घात् ङ्यन्तात्, दीर्घात् आबन्तात् च परस्य सुँ-ति-सि-प्रत्ययानाम् अपृक्तः हल् लुप्यते ।
6.1.68.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.69.v: The consonant of the nominative-affix (सु and its substitute अम् ) is elided in the Vocative singular after a nominal-stem ending in ए or ओ or a short vowel.
6.1.69.e: The हल् letter that belongs to a सम्बुद्धिप्रत्यय attached to एङन्त or ह्रस्वान्त word is removed.
6.1.69.sa: एङन्तात् / ह्रस्वान्तात् शब्दात् विहितस्य सम्बोधनैकवचनप्रत्ययस्य हल्-वर्णः लुप्यते ।
6.1.69.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.70.v: In the छन्दस् , the elision of the case-ending इ (शि) of the nominative and accusative plural neuter, is optional.
6.1.70.e: In वेदाः, 'शि' is seen removed at some places.
6.1.70.sa: वैदिकप्रयोगेषु कुत्रचित् 'शि' इत्यस्य लोपः कृतः दृश्यते ।
6.1.70.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.71.v: To a root ending in a short vowel is added the augment त् (तुक्) when a कृत्-affix having an indicatory प् follows.
6.1.71.e: A ह्रस्व letter that is followed by a कृत्-प्रत्यय that is पित् gets a तुगागम.
6.1.71.sa: ह्रस्वस्वरस्य कृत्-संज्ञके पित्-प्रत्यये परे तुगागमः भवति ।
6.1.71.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.72.v: In the following sutras up to [[6.1.157]] inclusive, the words संहितायाम् 'in an unbroken flow of speech', should be supplied.
6.1.72.e: This is an अधिकार that runs till > [[6.1.157]]. Anything told in this अधिकार happens only in the context of संहिता.
6.1.72.sa: इतः आरभ्य > [[6.1.157]] इति यावत् यद् किमपि उच्यते तत् संहिताया: विषये एव भवति ।
6.1.72.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.73.v: The augment त् is added to a preceding short vowel also when छ follows an in an uninterrupted speech.
6.1.73.e: A ह्रस्व स्वर gets a तुक्-आगमः when followed by a छकार, in the context of संहिता.
6.1.73.sa: ह्रस्वस्वरस्य छकारे परे संहितायाम् तुक्-आगमः भवति ।
6.1.73.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.74.v: The augment त् is added to the particle आ and the prohibitive particle मा , when छ follows an in a continuous text.
6.1.74.e: The words आङ् and माङ् get a तुक्-आगम when followed by a छकार, in the context of संहिता.
6.1.74.sa: आङ्-इत्यस्य माङ्-इत्यस्य च छकारे परे संहितायाम्  तुगागमः भवति ।
6.1.74.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.75.v: The augment त् is added to a long vowel, when followed by छ in a continuous text.
6.1.75.e: A दीर्घ स्वर gets a तुक्-आगमः when followed by a छकार,  in the context of संहिता.
6.1.75.sa: दीर्घ-स्वरस्य छकारे परे संहितायाम्  तुगागमः भवति ।
6.1.75.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.76.v: The augment त् is added optionally to a long vowel final in a full word (पद) when followed by छ।
6.1.76.e: A दीर्घ स्वर at end of a पद gets optional तुक्-आगमः when followed by a छकार,  in the context of संहिता.
6.1.76.sa: पदान्ते विद्यमानस्य दीर्घ-स्वरस्य छकारे परे संहितायाम् विकल्पेन तुगागमः भवति ।
6.1.76.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.77.v: The semi-vowels य् व् र् ल् are the substitutes of the corresponding vowels इ उ ऋ and ऌ (long and short), when followed by a vowel.
6.1.77.e: An इक् letter which is followed by a स्वर is converted to a corresponding यण् letter in the context of संहिता.
6.1.77.sa: इक्-वर्णस्य स्थाने स्वरे परे संहितायाम् यण्-वर्णादेशः भवति ।
6.1.77.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.78.v: For the vowels ए ऐ ओ and औ are respectively substituted अय् आय् अव् and आव् when a vowel follows.
6.1.78.e: When followed by a स्वर, the letters of the एच् प्रत्याहार are respectively converted to अय्, अव्, आय् and आव् in the context of संहिता.
6.1.78.sa: एच्-वर्णानाम् स्थाने संहितायाम् स्वरे परे (क्रमेण) अय्-अव्-आय्-आव्- एते आदेशाः भवन्ति ।
6.1.78.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.79.v: The substitution of अव् and आव् for ओ and औ also takes place before an affix beginning with य।
6.1.79.e: An ओकार and an औकार are respectively converted to अव् and आव् when followed by a यकारादि प्रत्यय, in the context of संहिता.
6.1.79.sa: ओकार-औकारयोः यकारादि-प्रत्यये परे संहितायाम् क्रमेण अव्/आव् आदेशौ भवन्तः ।
6.1.79.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.80.v: For the final dipthongs ओ and औ of a root, are substituted अव् and आव् respectively, before an affix beginning with य् , then only when such diphthong has been itself first evolved by that affix.
6.1.80.e: In the context of संहिता, the ओकार/औकार at the end of a धातु, when followed by यकारादि-प्रत्यय, is converted to अव् / आव्  only if that ओकार/औकार is generated by that यकारादिप्रत्यय itself.
6.1.80.sa: यकारादौ प्रत्यये परे संहितायाम् धातोः ओकार-औकारयोः वान्तादेशः तदा एव भवति यदा सः ओकारः/औकारः तेन यकारादि-प्रत्ययेन निर्मितः अस्ति ।
6.1.80.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.81.v: In क्षय्य and जय्य there is substitution of अय् for ए only then when the sense is that of 'to be possible to do'.
6.1.81.e: The words क्षय्य and जय्य are considered to be derived, in the meaning of (respectively) 'the one that is capable of being destroyed' and 'the one that is capable of being won over'.
6.1.81.sa: 'शक्यम्' अस्मिन् अर्थे 'क्षय्य' तथा 'जय्य' एतौ शब्दौ निपात्येते ।
6.1.81.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.82.v: In the क्रय्य there is substitution of अय् for ए when the sense is that of 'exposed or put out for sale, saleable'.
6.1.82.e: The words क्रय्य is considered to be derived, in the meaning of 'the one that can be purchased'.
6.1.82.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.83.v: The forms भय्य and प्रवय्य are found in the छन्दस
6.1.83.e: In the context of Vedas, the words भय्य (the one from which somebody is afraid) and the word प्रवय्या (= a female being impregnated) are seen used (and should thus be considered derived).
6.1.83.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.84.v: From here up to [[6.1.111]] inclusive is always to be supplied the phrase 'for the preceding and the following is substituted'.
6.1.84.e: This is an अधिकार that runs till > [[6.1.111]]. Any आदेश told in this अधिकार should be understood as combined आदेश done on the participating entities.
6.1.84.sa: इतः आरभ्य > [[6.1.111]] इति यावत्  यः कोऽपि आदेशः उच्यते सः पूर्वपरयोः उभयोः स्थाने एकादेशः भवति ।
6.1.84.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.85.v: And this single substitute is considered as the final of the preceding (form) and the initial of the succeeding (form).
6.1.85.e: The एकादेश told in the एकः पूर्वपरयोः अधिकार acts like the last letter of the पूर्वशब्द as well as the first letter of the परशब्द.
6.1.85.sa: 'एकः पूर्वपरयोः' अस्मिन् अधिकारे उक्तः एकादेशः पूर्वशब्दस्य अन्तिमवर्णवत्, तथा परशब्दस्य आदिवर्णवत्  भवति ।
6.1.85.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.86.v: The substitution of the final आदेश is to be considered as to have not taken effect, when otherwise स would have changed to ष , or when the augment त् (तुक्) is to be added.
6.1.86.e: The एकादेश mentioned under the एकः पूर्वपरयोः अधिकार should be considered असिद्ध while doing षत्वम् or a तुक् आगम.
6.1.86.sa: 'एकः पूर्वपरयोः' अस्मिन्  अधिकारे उक्तः एकादेशः षत्वार्थम्  तुक्-आगमार्थम् च असिद्धः अस्ति ।
6.1.86.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.87.v: The गुण is the single substitute of the final अ or आ of a preceding word and the simple vowel of the succeeding (अ or आ + a vowel = गुण)।
6.1.87.e: When an अवर्ण is followed by an अच् letter in the context of संहिता, both of them are replaced by a single गुण letter
6.1.87.sa: अवर्णात् अच्-वर्णे परे संहितायाम् पूर्वपरयोः एकः गुणः आदेशः भवति ।
6.1.87.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.88.v: The वृद्धि is the single substitute of अ or आ of a preceding word and the initial diphthong of the succeeding (अ or आ + diphthong = वृद्धि)।
6.1.88.e: When an अवर्ण is followed by an एच् letter in the context of संहिता, both of them are replaced by a single वृद्धि letter.
6.1.88.sa: अवर्णात् एच्-वर्णे परे संहितायाम् पूर्वपरयोः एकः वृद्धि-एकादेशः भवति ।
6.1.88.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.89.v: The वृद्धि is the single substitute of अ or आ + ए of एति (root इ) and एधति (root एध), and for अ or आ + ऊ of उठ (the substitute of वा in वाह by [[6.4.132]]).
6.1.89.e: In the context of संहिता, When an अवर्ण followed by the एच् letter of the इण् धातु or एध् धातु, or the word ऊठ् ; both of them are replaced by a single वृद्धि letter.
6.1.89.sa: अवर्णात् इण्-धातोः एध्-धातोः च एच्-वर्णे परे तथा ऊठ्-शब्दे परे संहितायाम् पूर्वपरयोः एकः वृद्धि-आदेशः भवति ।
6.1.89.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.90.v: The वृद्धि is the single substitute when the augment आट् is followed by any vowel.
6.1.90.e: When the आट्-आगम is followed by a अच्-letter,  both of them are replaced by a single वृद्धि letter.
6.1.90.sa: आट्-आगमात् अच्-वर्णे परे उभयोः एकः वृद्धि-एकादेशः भवति ।
6.1.90.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.91.v: The वृद्धि is the single substitute when the अ or आ of a preposition (उपसर्ग) is followed by the short ऋ of a verb.
6.1.91.e: When an अवर्णान्त उपसर्ग is followed by a  ऋकारादि verb form,  both of them are replaced by a single वृद्धि letter.
6.1.91.sa: अवर्णान्तात् उपसर्गात् ऋकारादौ धातुरूपे परे पूर्वपरयोः एकः वृद्धि-एकादेशः भवति ।
6.1.91.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.92.v: According to the opinion of आपिशलि, the वृद्धि is optionally the single substitute, when the अ or आ of a preposition is followed by a Denominative Verb beginning with ऋ।
6.1.92.e: When an अवर्णान्त उपसर्ग is followed by a ऋकारादि सुब्धातु, both of them are optionally replaced by a single वृद्धि letter.
6.1.92.sa: अवर्णान्तात् उपसर्गात् ऋकारादौ सुब्धातौ परे विकल्पेन पूर्वपरयोः एकः वृद्धि-एकादेशः भवति ।
6.1.92.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.93.v: For the ओ of a nominal stem + अ of the Accusative case-ending अम् and अस् the single substitute is आ।
6.1.93.e: When an ओकार  is followed by the अम्-प्रत्यय or the शस्-प्रत्यय,  both the letters are replaced by single आकार.
6.1.93.sa: ओकारात् अम्/शस्-प्रत्यये परे पूर्वपरयोः एकः आकारादेशः भवति ।
6.1.93.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.94.v: For the अ or आ of the Preposition + ए or ओ of a verbal root, the second vowel is the single substitute.
6.1.94.e: When an अवर्णान्त उपसर्ग is followed by a एकारादि or ओकारादि verb form, both the letters are replaced by a single पररूप.
6.1.94.sa: अवर्णान्तात् उपसर्गात् एकारादि/ओकारादि-धातुरूपे परे पूर्वपरयोः एकः पररूपः आदेशः भवति ।
6.1.94.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.95.v: For the अ or आ of ओम् or + the vowel of the Preposition आङ् , the second vowel is the single substitute.
6.1.95.e: In the context of संहिता, When अवर्ण is followed by the word ओम् or the word आङ् , both the letters are replaced by a single पररूप.
6.1.95.sa: अवर्णात् ओम्-शब्दे परे आङ्-शब्दे च परे संहितायाम् पूर्वपरयोः एकः पररूप-एकादेशः भवति ।
6.1.95.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.96.v: For the अ or आ (not standing at the end of a पद or full word) + उ of उस the Tense-affix, the second vowel is the single substitute.
6.1.96.e: In the context of संहिता, ऌhen a अवर्ण not occurring at end of a पद is followed by the word 'उस्', both of them are replaced by a single पररूप.
6.1.96.sa: अपदान्त-अवर्णात् 'उस्' शब्दे परे संहितायाम् पूर्वपरयोः एकः पररूप-एकादेशः भवति ।
6.1.96.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.97.v: Also when the short अ , not being final in a पद , is followed by a गुण letter, then in the room of both the precedent and the subsequent - the single substitute is the form of the subsequent i.e. the गुण।
6.1.97.e: In the context of संहिता, when an अपदान्त अकार is followed by a गुण letter, both of them are replaced by a single पररूप.
6.1.97.sa: अपदान्त-अकारात् गुणे परे संहितायाम् पूर्वपरयोः एकः पररूप-एकादेशः भवति ।
6.1.97.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.98.v: The इ of इति is the single substitute for the अत् (of a word denoting imitation of an inarticulate sound) + इति।
6.1.98.e: In the context of संहिता, When a word which is used to imitate some abstract sound and which ends is the phrase 'अत्' is followed by the word 'इति', then the 'अत्' of the previous word and the इ of इति are combined to form a पररूप-एकादेश.
6.1.98.sa: अव्यक्तानुकरणवाचिपदस्य अन्ते विद्यमानः यः 'अत्' इति अंश, तस्मात् इति-शब्दे परे संहितायाम् पूर्वपरयोः एकः पररूप-एकादेशः भवति ।
6.1.98.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.99.v: This substitution does not take place when a sound-imitation word is doubled, here, however, for the final त् + इ , the single substitute is optionally इ (the second vowel).
6.1.99.e: When a word which is used to imitate some abstract sound and which ends is the phrase 'अत्' and which is also an आम्रेडितसंज्ञक is followed by the word 'इति', then the 'अत्' of the previous word and the इ of इति are not combined as mentioned in the previous rule 'अव्यक्तानुकरणस्यात इतौ'. Instead, the त् and इ optionally combine to form a पररूप-एकादेश.
6.1.99.sa: अव्यक्तानुकरणवाचिशब्दस्य अन्ते विद्यमानः 'अत्' इति अंशः आम्रेडितसंज्ञकस्य अस्ति चेत् तस्मात् इति-शब्दे परे > [[6.1.98]] इति पूर्वसूत्रेण उक्तः पररूप-एकादेशः न भवति, अपितु तकार-इकारयोः विकल्पेन पररूप-एकादेशः भवति ।
6.1.99.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.100.v: Of such a doubled sound-imitation word, to which the affix आ is added which causes elision of the final अत् , for the final त् of the first member and the initial consonant of the second member, such subsequent consonant is always the single substitute.
6.1.100.e: When a word which is used to imitate some abstract sound and which ends is the phrase 'त्' is followed by an आम्रेडितसंज्ञक which is further followed by the pratyay डाच्, then the 'त्' of the first word and the first letter of the आम्रेडितसंज्ञक are combined to form a पररूप-एकादेश.
6.1.100.sa: यदि अव्यक्तानुकरणवाचिशब्दस्य अन्ते विद्यमानात् तकारात् परः आम्रेडितसंज्ञकः शब्दः विद्यते, तथा च आम्रेडितसंज्ञकात् परः डाच्-प्रत्ययः विहितः अस्ति,  तर्हि तस्य अव्यक्तानुकरणवाचिशब्दस्य अन्तिमः वर्णः तथा च आम्रेडितसंज्ञकस्य आदिवर्णः - एतयोः पररूप-एकादेशः भवति ।
6.1.100.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.101.v: When a single vowel is followed by a homogenous vowel, the corresponding long vowel is the single substitute for both the precedent and the subsequent vowels.
6.1.101.e: In the context of संहिता, when an अक् letter is followed by a सवर्ण अच् letter, both of them are replaced by a दीर्घ-एकादेश.
6.1.101.sa: अक्-वर्णात्  सवर्णे अच्-वर्णे परे संहितायाम् पूर्वपरयोः एकः दीर्घ-एकादेशः भवति ।
6.1.101.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.102.v: For the simple vowel of a nominal-stem and for the vowel of the case-affixes of the Nominative and the Accusative in all numbers, there is the single substitution of a long vowel corresponding to the first vowel.
6.1.102.e: When a letter from the  अक् प्रत्याहार is followed by an अजादि प्रत्यय of  प्रथमा or द्वितीया विभक्ति, then पूर्व and the पर letters are replaced by a single पूर्वसवर्णदीर्घ.
6.1.102.sa: अक्-वर्णात् प्रथमा-द्वितीया-विभक्त्योः अजादि प्रत्यये परे पूर्वपरयोः एकः पूर्वसवर्णदीर्घः भवति ।
6.1.102.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.103.v: After such a long vowel homogenous with the first, न् is substituted for the स् of the Acccusative case affix शस् in the masculine.
6.1.103.e: When the rule 'प्रथमयोः पूर्वसवर्णः' is used to create a पूर्वसवर्णदीर्घ for a पुंलिङ्ग word in presence of the शस्-प्रत्यय, then the सकार of the शस्-प्रत्यय is converted to नकार.
6.1.103.sa: पुंलिङ्गशब्दात् शस्-प्रत्यये परे > [[6.1.102]] इति सूत्रेण पूर्वसवर्णदीर्घे कृते तस्मात् अनन्तरम् विद्यमानस्य शस्-प्रत्ययस्य सकारस्य नकारादेशः भवति ।
6.1.103.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.104.v: The substitution of a long vowel homogenous with the first, does not take place when अ or आ is followed by a vowel (other than अ) of the case-affixes of the Nominative and the Accusative.
6.1.104.e: When अकार / आकार is followed by a प्रत्यय of प्रथमा or द्वितीया विभक्ति that begins with a letter of इच्-प्रत्याहार, then the पूर्वसवर्णदीर्घ given by 'प्रथमयोः पूर्वसवर्णः' does not happen.
6.1.104.sa: अवर्णात् प्रथमा-द्वितीययोः इच्-वर्णे परे > [[6.1.102]] इत्यनेन पूर्वसवर्णदीर्घः न भवति ।
6.1.104.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.105.v: The substitution of a long vowel homogenous with the first, does not take place when a long vowel is followed by a nominative or accusative case-affix beginning with a vowel (other than अ) or by the Nominative Plural affix अस्।
6.1.105.e: When दीर्घस्वर is followed by either the जस्-प्रत्यय, or a प्रत्यय of प्रथमा or द्वितीया विभक्ति that begins with a letter of इच्-प्रत्याहार, then the पूर्वसवर्णदीर्घ mandated by 'प्रथमयोः पूर्वसवर्णः' does not happen.
6.1.105.sa: दीर्घस्वरात्  प्रथमा-द्वितीययोः इच्-वर्णे परे तथा प्रथमा-बहुवचनस्य जस्-प्रत्यये परे  > [[6.1.102]] इत्यनेन पूर्वसवर्णदीर्घः न भवति ।
6.1.105.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.106.v: In the Vedas, the long vowel may optionally be the single substitute of both vowels in these cases last mentioned.
6.1.106.e: The पूर्वसवर्णदीर्घनिषेध given by the sutra 'दीर्घाज्जसि च' is optional while deriving the Vedic forms.
6.1.106.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.107.v: There is the single substitution of the first vowel, when a simple vowel is followed by the अ of the case ending अम्।
6.1.107.e: When a letter from the अक् प्रत्याहार is followed अकार of the अम्-प्रत्यय, both the letters are combined to form a पूर्वरूप-एकादेश.
6.1.107.sa: अक्-वर्णात् अम्-प्रत्ययस्य अकारे परे पूर्वपरयोः एकः पूर्वरूप-एकादेशः भवति ।
6.1.107.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.108.v: There is the single substitution of the first vowel for the vocalised semi-vowel and the subsequent vowel.
6.1.108.e: When a letter having the sanjna सम्प्रसारण is followed by an अच् letter, both of them are combined to form a पूर्वरूप-एकादेश.
6.1.108.sa: सम्प्रसारणसंज्ञकात् वर्णात् अच् वर्णे परे पूर्वपरयोः  एकः पूर्वरूप-एकादेशः भवति ।
6.1.108.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.109.v: In the room of ए or ओ final in a पद , and the short अ , which follows it, is substituted the single vowel of the form of the first (ए or ओ)।
6.1.109.e: If a पदान्त ए / ओ letter is followed by a ह्रस्व अकार, then both of them combine to form a पूर्वरूप एकादेश.
6.1.109.sa: पदान्त-एङ्-वर्णात् ह्रस्व-अकारे परे पूर्वपरयोः एकः पूर्वरूप-एकादेशः भवति ।
6.1.109.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.110.v: In the room of ए or ओ (in the body of a word), + अ of the case-affix अस् of the Ablative and Genitive Singular, the single substitute is the form of the precedent.
6.1.110.e: If an एकार or ओकार is followed by the अकार of ङसिँ or ङस् प्रत्यय,  then both of them combined to form a पूर्वरूप एकादेश.
6.1.110.sa: एङ्-वर्णात् ङसिँ/ङस्-प्रत्यययोः अकारे परे  पूर्वपरयोः एकः पूर्वरूप-एकादेशः भवति ।
6.1.110.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.111.v: In the room of ऋ + अ of the case-affix अस् of the Ablative and Genitive singular, the single substitute is the letter short उ।
6.1.111.e: If a ऋकार or ऌकार is followed by the अकार of  ङसिँ or ङस् प्रत्यय,  then both of them combined to form an उकार.
6.1.111.sa: ऋवर्णात् /ऌवर्णात्  ङसिँ/ङस्-प्रत्यययोः अकारे परे पूर्वपरयोः एकः उकारादेशः भवति ।
6.1.111.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.112.v: There is the substitution of उ for the अ of अस् of the Ablative and Genitive Singular after सखि and पति , when for the इ of those two stems य् is substituted.
6.1.112.e: The अकार of the  ङसिँ/ङस् प्रत्यय following a 'ख्य्' / 'त्य्' is converted to उकार.
6.1.112.sa: 'ख्य्' / 'त्य्' इत्यस्मात् परस्य ङसिँ/ङस् प्रत्ययस्य अकारस्य उकारादेशः भवति ।
6.1.112.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.113.v: The उ is the substitute of रु (the र् substitute of a final स् [[8.2.66]]) when an अ , which is not a प्लुत, both precedes and follows it.
6.1.113.e: A रुँ letter that is sandwiched between an अप्लुत-ह्रस्व-अकार from each side is converted to an उकार.
6.1.113.sa: अप्लुत-ह्रस्व-अकारात् परस्य रुँ-इत्यस्य अप्लुत-ह्रस्व-अकारे परे उकारादेशः भवति ।
6.1.113.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.114.v: The उ is the substitute of रु (the र् substitute of a final स् [[8.2.66]]) when it is followed by a soft consonant and preceded by an अप्लुत short अ।
6.1.114.e: A रुँ letter that follows an अप्लुत-ह्रस्व-अकार and is followed by a हश् letter is converted to an उकार.
6.1.114.sa: अप्लुत-ह्रस्व-अकारात् परस्य रुँ-इत्यस्य हश्-वर्णे परे उकारादेशः भवति ।
6.1.114.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.115.v: The final ए or ओ and the following अ when occurring in the middle half of a foot of a Vedic verse, retain their original forms, except when the अ is followed by ख् or य्।

6.1.116.v: The ए or ओ retain their original form in the middle of a Vedic verse, when the following words come after them (though the अ in these has a व् and य् following it) - अव्यात् , अवद्यात् , अवक्रमुः , अव्रत , अवन्तु , अवस्यु।

6.1.117.v: In the यजुर्वेद , the word उरस् when changed to उरो , retains it original form when followed by a short अ which is also retained.

6.1.118.v: In the यजुर्वेद , the short अ is retained after आपो , जुषाणो , वृष्णो , वर्षिष्ठे and also in and after अम्बे or अम्बाले when they stand before अम्बिके।

6.1.119.v: In the यजुर्वेद , when the word अङ्गे is followed by अङ्गे , the subsequent short अ is retained, as well as the preceding ए or ओ।

6.1.120.v: In the यजुर्वेद , when an अनुदात्त अ is followed by a Guttural or a ध, the antecedent ए or ओ retains it s form, as well as this subsequent अ।

6.1.121.v: In the यजुर्वेद , when the gravely accented अ of अवपथास् follows ए or ओ , the vowels retain their original form.

6.1.122.v: After गो the subsequent अ may optionally be retained everywhere, in the Vedas as well as in the secular literature.
6.1.122.e: In the context of संहिता, an ओकार occurring at the end of the पदसंज्ञक गो शब्द exhibits optional प्रकृतिभाव when followed by a ह्रस्व अकार.
6.1.122.sa: पदसंज्ञकस्य गो-शब्दस्य अन्ते विद्यमानस्य ओकारस्य ह्रस्व अकारे परे संहितायाम् लोके वेदे च विकल्पेन प्रकृतिभावः भवति ।
6.1.122.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.123.v: According to the opinion of स्फोटायन , there is the substitution of अवङ् for the ओ of गो when it is followed by any vowel.
6.1.123.e: In the context of संहिता, The पदसंज्ञक गो word when followed by a स्वर gets an अवङ् आदेश optionally.
6.1.123.sa: पदसंज्ञकस्य गो-शब्दस्य स्वरे परे संहितायाम् विकल्पेन अवङ्-आदेशः भवति ।
6.1.123.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.124.v: The substitution of अव for the ओ of गो is compulsory when a vowel to be found in the word इन्द्र follows it.
6.1.124.e: In the context of संहिता, The word गो when followed by the word इन्द्र gets the अवङ्-आदेश.
6.1.124.sa: गो-शब्दस्य इन्द्र-शब्दे परे संहितायाम् अवङ्-आदेशः भवति ।
6.1.124.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.125.v: The प्लुत ([[8.2.82]] etc.) and प्रगृह्य ([[1.1.11]] etc.) vowels remain unaltered when followed by a vowel (so far as the operation of that vowel is concerned).
6.1.125.e: प्लुत letters and प्रगृह्य words do not undergo a सन्धि when followed by an अच्-letter, even when there is संहिता.
6.1.125.sa: प्लुतवर्णेभ्यः प्रगृह्यसंज्ञकशब्देभ्यः अनन्तरम् संहितायाम् स्वरः विद्यते चेद् अपि तत्र सन्धिः न भवति ।
6.1.125.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.126.v: For the adverb आ , is substituted in the छन्दस् the nasalised आँ , when a vowel follows it, and it retains its original form.
6.1.126.e: In the context of संहिता and in the derivation of the वैदिक forms, when आङ् is followed by an अच् letter, आङ् becomes अनुनासिक and does not undergo sandhi with the अच् letter.
6.1.126.sa: वैदिकप्रक्रियायाम् आङ् इत्यस्य संहितायाम् अच्-वर्णे परे अनुनासिकादेशः भवति, ततः च अच्-वर्णेन सह सन्धिः न भवति ।
6.1.126.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.127.v: According to the opinion of शाकल्य , the simple vowels with the exception of अ , when followed by a non-homogenous vowel, retain their original forms; and if the vowel is long, it is shortened.
6.1.127.e: According to शाकल्य, In the context of संहिता a पदान्त-इक्-letter, when followed by an असवर्ण अच्-letter undergoes ह्रस्वादेशः and then no other sandhi happens.
6.1.127.sa: पदान्त-इक्-वर्णस्य असवर्णे अचि परे संहितायाम् शाकल्यस्य मतेन ह्रस्वादेशः भवति, तदनन्तरं च सन्धिकार्यं न भवति ।
6.1.127.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.128.v: According to the opinion of शाकल्य , the simple vowel followed by ऋ retains its original form, and if the vowel is long, it is shortened.
6.1.128.e: According to शाकल्य, In the context of संहिता a पदान्त-अक्-letter, when followed by a ह्रस्व ऋ/ऌ-letter undergoes ह्रस्वादेशः and then no other sandhi happens.
6.1.128.sa: पदान्त-अक्-वर्णस्य ह्रस्व-ऋकारे/ऌकारे परे संहितायाम् शाकल्यस्य मतेन ह्रस्वादेशः भवति, तदनन्तरं च सन्धिकार्यं न भवति ।
6.1.128.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.129.v: Before the word इति in the पदपाठ , a प्लुत vowel is treated like an ordinary अप्लुत vowel.
6.1.129.e: When followed by an अवैदिक 'इति' word, a प्लुत behaves as if it is not प्लुत in the context of संहिता.
6.1.129.sa: संहितायाम् अवैदिके 'इति' शब्दे परे प्लुतः अप्लुतवत् भवति ।
6.1.129.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.130.v: According to the opinion of चाक्रवर्मण , the प्लुत ई3 followed by a vowel is treated like an ordinary vowel.
6.1.130.e: According to चाक्रवर्मण, the प्लुतः ईकारः behaves as if it is not प्लुत when followed by an अच्-letter in the context of संहिता.
6.1.130.sa: चाक्रवर्मणस्य मतेन प्लुतः ईकारः संहितायाम् अचि परे अप्लुतवत् भवति ।
6.1.130.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.131.v: For the final of the nominal-stem दिव् , there is the substitution of उ , when it is a पद ([[1.4.14]] etc.).
6.1.131.e: The 'दिव्' word that is a पद also gets the उत्-आदेश.
6.1.131.sa: 'दिव्' इत्यस्य पदसंज्ञायां सत्याम् तस्य उत्-आदेशः भवति ।
6.1.131.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.132.v: After एतद् and तद् there is elision of the case-affix स् (of the Nominative Singular), when a consonant follows it, when these words are not combined with क ([[5.3.71]]) and have not the Negative Particle in composition.
6.1.132.e: Except for the नञ् समास, when a form of एतद्/तद् word which does not contain a ककार is followed by a  सुँ-प्रत्यय which in turn is followed by a व्यञ्जन. the सुँ-प्रत्यय gets removed in the context of संहिता.
6.1.132.sa: नञ्-समासं विहाय अन्यत्र ककारविहीनात् एतद्/तद्-शब्दात् परस्य सुँ-प्रत्ययस्य व्यञ्जने परे संहितायाः विषये लोपः भवति ।
6.1.132.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.133.v: In the छन्दस् , the case-affix of the nominative singular is diversely elided after स्य , when a consonant follows it.
6.1.133.e: In the derivation of the Vedic words, the सुँ-प्रत्यय attached to the प्रथमा-एकवचन of the word त्यद् might or might not be removed when followed by a हल् in the context of संहिता.
6.1.133.sa: वैदिकप्रक्रियायाम् त्यद्-शब्दस्य प्रथमैकवचनस्य सुँ-प्रत्ययस्य संहितायाः विषये हलि परे बहुलं लोपः भवति ।
6.1.133.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.134.v: The case affix of सस् 'he', is elided before a vowel, if by such elision the meter of the foot becomes complete.
6.1.134.e: The सुँ-प्रत्यय of सः gets removed when followed by an अच्, provided that (only) by doing so, the पाद can be completed.
6.1.134.sa: 'सः' इत्यत्र विद्यमानस्य सुँ-प्रत्ययस्य संहितायाम् अचि परे पादपूरणार्थं लोप: भवति, यदि तादशम् एव पादपूरणम् सम्भवति ।
6.1.134.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.135.v: Up to [[6.1.157]] inclusive, the following sentence is to be supplied in every aphorism - 'before क is added स्'.

6.1.136.v: The augment सुट् is placed before क even when the augment अट् [[6.4.71]] or the Reduplicate intervenes (between the preposition and the verb).

6.1.137.v: The augment सुट् is placed before क when सम् , परि , and उप are followed by the verb कृ and the sense is that of ornamenting.

6.1.138.v: The augment सुट् is placed before क even when सम् , परि , and उप are followed by the verb कृ and the sense being that of combining.

6.1.139.v: The augment सुट् is placed before क , when the verb कृ comes after उप , and the sense is that of 'to take pains for something, to prepare, and to supply and ellipses in a discourse'.

6.1.140.v: The augment सुट् is placed before क , when the verb कृ comes after उप , and the sense is that of 'to cut or to split'.

6.1.141.v: The augment सुट् is placed before क , when the verb कृ comes after उप and प्रति and the sense 'to cause suffering'.

6.1.142.v: The augment सुट् is placed before क , when the verb कृ comes after अप and the sense is 'the scraping of earth by four-footed animals or birds'.

6.1.143.v: The word कुस्तुम्बुरु is irregularly, formed with the augment सुट् and means 'a species of herb'.

6.1.144.v: The word अपस्पराः is formed by the augment सुट् when the sense is that of 'uninterrupted action'.

6.1.145.v: The word गोष्पद is formed by सुट् , when meaning a locality visited or not visited by cows, or when it means quantity.

6.1.146.v: The word आस्पद is formed by सुट् when meaning 'a place or position'.

6.1.147.v: The word आशचर्य is formed by सुट् when meaning something 'unusual'.

6.1.148.v: The word अवस्कर is formed by सुट् meaning 'excrement'.

6.1.149.v: The word अपस्कर is formed by सुट् meaning 'the part of a chariot'.

6.1.150.v: The word विषिकर is formed with सुट् optionally when denoting a kind of bird, the other form being विकार।

6.1.151.v: In a मन्त्र , the सुट् is added to चन्द्र when it is second member in a compound and is preceded by a short vowel.

6.1.152.v: To the root कश् 'to go, to punish', is added the augment सुट् , when preceded by the preposition प्रति , the form being प्रतिष्कशः।

6.1.153.v: The words प्रस्कण्व and हरिश्चन्द्र are formed by सुट् meaning the two Rishis of that name.

6.1.154.v: The word मस्कर means 'a bamboo', and मस्करिन् means 'a medicant monk'.

6.1.155.v: The words कास्तर and अजस्तुन्द are names of cities.

6.1.157.v: The words पारस्कर etc. are Names.

6.1.158.v: A word is, with the exception of one syllable, unaccented.
6.1.158.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.159.v: A stem formed with the कृत-affix घञ् has the acute accent on the end-syllable, if it is formed from the root कृष् (कर्षति) or has a long आ in it.

6.1.160.v: The words उच्छ etc. have acute accent on the last syllable.

6.1.161.v: An unaccented vowel gets also the acute accent, when on account of it preceding acute is elided.

6.1.162.v: A root has the acute on the end syllable.

6.1.163.v: A stem (formed by an affix or an augment or substitute) having an indicatory च् gets acute on the end syllable.
6.1.163.e: The word ending in चित्-प्रत्यय becomes अन्तोदात्त.
6.1.163.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.164.v: A stem formed with a तद्धित-affix having an indicatory च् , has acute on the end syllable.
6.1.164.e: The word ending in a तद्धितसंज्ञक चित्-प्रत्यय become अन्तोदात्त.
6.1.164.sa: यः तद्धित-प्रत्ययः चित्-अस्ति, सः यस्य समुदायस्य अन्ते आगच्छति, तस्य समुदायस्य अन्तिम-स्वरः उदात्तः भवति ।
6.1.164.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.165.v: A stem formed by a तद्धित-affix having an indicatory क , has acute accent on the end syllable.
6.1.165.e: The word ending in a तद्धितसंज्ञक कित्-प्रत्यय become अन्तोदात्त.
6.1.165.sa: यः तद्धित-प्रत्ययः कित्-अस्ति, सः यस्य समुदायस्य अन्ते आगच्छति, तस्य समुदायस्य अन्तिम-स्वरः उदात्तः भवति ।
6.1.165.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.166.v: The Nominative Plural (जस्) of तिस् has acute accent on the last syllable.

6.1.167.v: The word चतुर् , followed by the Accusative Plural, has acute accent on the last syllable.

6.1.168.v: The case affixes of the Instrumental and of the cases that follow it have the acute accent, if the stem in the Locative Plural is monosyllabic.

6.1.169.v: The same case endings may optionally have the acute accent, if the monosyllabic word stands at the end of a compound, and has acute accent on the final, when the compound can be easily unloosened.

6.1.170.v: In the छन्दस् , the case-endings other than the सर्वनामस्थान , get the acute accent when coming after अञ्चि।

6.1.171.v: The same (असर्वनामस्थान) case-endings have the acute accent, when the stem ends in वाह् , also after इदम् after पद् etc. (up to [[6.1.63]]) after अप , पुंस् , रै and दिव्।

6.1.172.v: The असर्वनामस्थान case-endings after अष्टन् 'eight', have acute accent, when it gets the form अष्टा।

6.1.173.v: After an oxytone Particle in अत् the feminine suffix ई , (नदि) and the case endings beginning with vowels (with the exception of strong cases) have acute accent, when the participial affix has not the augment न् (i.e. is not अन्त).

6.1.174.v: The same endings have the acute accent, when for the acutely accented final vowel of the stem, a semi-vowel is substituted, and which is preceded by a consonant.

6.1.175.v: But not so, when the vowel is of the feminine affix ऊ [[4.1.66]], or the final of a root.

6.1.176.v: The otherwise unaccented मत् (वत्) takes the acute accent, when an oxytoned stem ends in a light vowel, or the affix has before it the augment न् [[8.2.16]].

6.1.177.v: After an oxytoned stem which ends in a light vowel, the genitive ending नाम् has optionally the acute accent.

6.1.178.v: In the छन्दस , the ending नाम् has diversely the acute accent after the feminine affix ई।

6.1.179.v: The case-endings beginning with a consonant, have the acute accent after the Numerals called षट् [[1.1.24]], as well as after त्रि and चतुर् ।

6.1.180.v: The above numerals, when taking a case-affix beginning with a भस् or स् , get the acute accent on the penultimate syllable, when the said numerals assume a form consisting of three or more syllables.

6.1.181.v: In the Secular language this is optional.

6.1.182.v: The foregoing rules from [[6.1.168]] downwards have no applicability after गो , and श्वन् and words ending in them; nor after a stem which before the case ending of the Nominative Singular has अ or आ , nor after रज् , or after a stem ending in अञ्च् , nor as well as after कुञ्च् and कृत्।

6.1.183.v: After दिव् a case-ending beginning with भ or स is unaccented.

6.1.184.v: After नृ , a case-ending beginning with भ or स is optionally unaccented.

6.1.185.v: An affix having an indicatory त् , is स्वरित i.e. has circumflex accent.
6.1.185.e: The first स्वर of a तित् प्रत्यय becomes स्वरित.
6.1.185.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.186.v: The Personal-endings and their substitutes [[3.2.124]]-126 are, when they are सार्वधातुक [[3.4.113]] etc., unaccented after the characteristic of the Periphrastic Future (तासि) after a root which in the धातुपाठ has an unaccented vowel or a ङ् (with the exception of ह्नुङ् and इङ्) as indicatory letter, as well as after what has a final अ in the Grammatical System of Instruction (उपदेश)।

6.1.187.v: The सिच् Aorist, the first syllable may optionally have the acute accent.

6.1.188.v: The acute accent is optionally on the first syllable when a Personal-ending, being सार्वधातुक tense affix beginning with a vowel, provided that the vowel is not the augment इट् , follows after स्वप् etc., or after हिंस्।

6.1.189.v: The acute accent falls on the first syllable of the reduplicate verbs when followed by an affix beginning with a vowel (the vowel being not नुट्) and being a सार्वधातुक Personal-ending.

6.1.190.v: Also when the unaccented endings of the three persons in the singular follow, the first syllable of the reduplicate has the acute.

6.1.191.v: The acute is on the first syllable of सर्व when the case-endings follow.

6.1.192.v: In भी , ह्री , भृ , हु , मद् , जन् , धन् , दरिद्रा and जागृ , and in their reduplicates, the acute accent is, before the सार्वधातुक unaccented endings of the three persons in singular, (पित्), on the syllable which precedes the affix.

6.1.193.v: The acute accent falls on the syllable immediately preceding the affix that has an indicatory ल्।
6.1.193.e: For the प्रकृति-प्रत्यय-समुदाय that ends in a लित्-प्रत्यय, the स्वर that comes before the प्रत्यय becomes उदात्त.
6.1.193.sa: लित्-प्रत्यये परे प्रत्ययात् पूर्वमुपस्थितः स्वरः उदात्तः भवति ।
6.1.193.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.194.v: The first syllable may be optionally acute when the absolutive affix णमुल् follows.

6.1.195.v: The roots which are exhibited in धातुपाठ with a final vowel, may be optionally have the acute on the first syllable, before the affixes of the Passive (यक्), when the sense of the verb is Reflexive.

6.1.196.v: Before the ending थ of the Perfect, Second Person Singular, when this ending takes the augment इ ; the acute accent falls either on the first syllable, or on this इ , or on the personal ending.

6.1.197.v: Whatever is derived with an affix having an indicatory ञ् or न् , has the acute accent invariably on the first syllable.
6.1.197.e: The word ending in a ञित् or a नित् प्रत्यय become आद्युदात्त.
6.1.197.sa: ञित् प्रत्यये परे नित्-प्रत्यये च परे प्रकृति-प्रत्यय-समुदायस्य आदिस्वरः नित्यमुदात्तः भवति ।
6.1.197.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.198.v: The first syllable of a Vocative gets the acute accent.

6.1.199.v: The acute accent is on the first syllable of पथिन् and मथिन् when followed by a strong case-ending.

6.1.200.v: The Infinitive in तवै has the acute on the first syllable and on the last syllable at one and the same time.

6.1.201.v: The word क्षय has the acute on the first syllable and on the last syllable at one and the same time.

6.1.202.v: The acute accent falls on the first syllable of जय , in the sense of 'whereby one attains victory'.

6.1.203.v: The words वृष etc. have the acute on the first syllable.

6.1.204.v: The acute accent falls on the first syllable of that word with which something is likened, provided that it is a name.

6.1.205.v: A disyllabic Participle in त (निष्ठा) when a Name has the acute on the first syllable, but not if the first syllable has an आ।

6.1.206.v: Also शुष्क and धृष्ट have acute on the first syllable.

6.1.207.v: The word आशित meaning 'having eaten' has acute on the first syllable.

6.1.208.v: The word रिक्त may have optionally the acute on the first syllable.

6.1.209.v: In the छन्दस , the words जुष्ट and अर्पित have optionally the acute on the first syllable.

6.1.210.v: In the मन्त्राः , these words जुष्ट and अर्पित have always the acute on the first syllable.

6.1.211.v: The acute accent is on the first syllable of युष्मद् and अस्मद् in the Genitive Singular.

6.1.212.v: The acute accent is on the first syllable of युष्मद् and अस्मद् in the Dative Singular.

6.1.213.v: Whatever is formed by the affix यत् , has, if it is a disyllabic word, the acute on the first syllable, with the exception of नाव्यः from नौ।

6.1.214.v: The acute accent is on the first syllable of ईड् , वन्द , वृ , शंस् and दुह् , when they are followed by the affix ण्यत्।

6.1.215.v: The acute accent is optionally on the first syllable of वेणु and इन्धान।

6.1.216.v: The acute accent is optionally on the first syllables of त्याग , राग , हास , कुह , श्वठ , and क्रथ।

6.1.217.v: What is formed by an affix having an indicatory र , has acute on the penultimate syllable, the full word consisting of more than two syllables.
6.1.217.e: The second last  स्वर of the प्रकृति-प्रत्यय-समुदाय that ends in a रित् प्रत्यय becomes उदात्त.
6.1.217.sa: रित्-प्रत्यये परे प्रकृति-प्रत्यय-समुदायस्य उपोत्तमः स्वरः नित्यमुदात्तः भवति
6.1.217.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.1.218.v: The acute accent may be optionally on the penultimate syllable of the reduplicated Aorist in चङ् , the word consisting of more than two syllables.

6.1.219.v: The आ before the affix मत् has the acute accent, when the word is a name in the Feminine Gender.

6.1.220.v: The Names ending in अवति have the acute accent on the last syllable.

6.1.221.v: The Names ending in ईवति have the acute on the last syllable.

6.1.222.v: In compound words ending in अञ्च् , the final vowel of the preceding word has the acute accent in the weak cases in which only च् of अञ्च् remains.

6.1.223.v: A compound word has the acute on the last syllable.
